headline: Unbeaten Lincoln win at Drury and cannot be caught
dek: Drury and Maryville have finished their conference matches level behind Lincoln, who host McKendree on Tuesday still without a defeat: eleven wins and four draws in all. Drury had not lost at home in conference play before Saturday.
displaced_by: Lincoln won at Drury, so the standing meeting of two sides level on points has been played; Drury and Maryville have finished their conference matches behind them, and Lincoln can no longer be caught.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-two goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-five and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln have the top of the table settled with a match still to play, and have not lost all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have conceded fourteen goals and lost three times: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, and at home to Lincoln on Saturday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has eleven of Lincoln's thirty-two goals, from fifty-five shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored twenty-five goals and conceded twenty-seven, and Jacob Panagos has fourteen of the twenty-five from forty-nine shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Lincoln have now won at both Maryville and Drury, the sides level behind them in the table.

next_match.line: Missouri S&T have not won since beating McKendree earlier this month; Missouri-St. Louis have scored fewer goals than any programme but William Jewell.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
